meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "Save as draft" — record what happens

plan.title: Record Save as Draft on Existing eRFX Draft

steps.note: Open the Events list as the buyer.
Confirm the events list rendered before navigating to drafts.
Open the Drafts tab requested by the case.
Open the existing saved eRFX draft; the draft reopens on its create screen.
Click only Save as draft and record what opens, changes, or remains unchanged.
Confirm the Save as draft control remains visible after the exploratory click.
Confirm the click did not produce an application error.
